featured_reviews.name: Deepak Sarang
featured_reviews.review_text:
My experience with Bombay Shirt Company was extremely disappointing, especially considering the premium pricing and the expectations that come with a bespoke tailoring service.

As a first-time customer, I purchased eight shirts and seven pairs of trousers, investing a significant amount of money based on the brand’s reputation. The experience during the sales process was excellent—attentive staff, impressive presentation, and repeated assurances regarding customization, fit, and quality.

Unfortunately, the experience changed completely after the order was placed.

The fitting process required multiple follow-ups from my side, and when the final garments were delivered, I discovered that some of the fabrics and specifications did not match the selections I had originally made. This was particularly frustrating because the entire purpose of choosing a bespoke service is to receive garments tailored exactly to one’s preferences.

What disappointed me even more was the lack of effective customer support afterward. Despite numerous attempts to seek clarification and resolution, I received responses that were dismissive and unhelpful. Instead of taking ownership of the issue, there appeared to be very little interest in resolving a genuine customer concern.

For a company positioning itself as a premium custom-clothing brand, attention to detail, order accuracy, and post-sales support should be non-negotiable. Sadly, my experience fell far short of those standards.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but given the amount spent and the overall experience, I feel it is important to share this feedback so that prospective customers can make an informed decision.

I hope Bombay Shirt Company reviews its quality-control processes and customer-service standards, because my experience did not justify the premium price paid.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Bombay Shirt Company store and was genuinely impressed by their Large Men Wear collection. The range covers shirts, trousers, T-shirts, and accessories, all thoughtfully designed for a refined, well-fitted look.

The real standout is their offline private luxury collection of 100% Giza cotton shirts. These are exclusive, premium pieces that truly feel luxurious. Once you wear a Giza cotton shirt, the difference is obvious — the fabric, finish, and comfort make you feel privileged, confident, and well dressed. This is luxury you can feel, not just see.

They also offer non-Giza cotton options which are stylish, well-made, and visually appealing — good choices for regular wear without compromising on quality.

Every item is custom-tailored as per the customer’s measurements and preferences, which is where Bombay Shirt Company really shines. The customization experience is smooth, professional, and clearly aimed at delivering a perfect fit rather than mass production.

One small miss (hence 1 star less):
While exclusivity and customization are a great concept, I strongly feel they should introduce one section of ready-to-wear garments for customers who want to buy and wear immediately. Currently, every purchase requires measurements, customization, and a waiting period. Sometimes, a customer just wants to walk in, fall in love with a piece, and walk out wearing it — that spontaneity is missing.

Overall:
Excellent fabrics, luxurious Giza cotton, great tailoring, and a premium in-store experience. Add a ready-to-wear section, and this brand would be close to flawless.

featured_reviews.name: Adv Surabhi Sawant
featured_reviews.review_text:
We walked into Bombay Shirt Company at Kemps Corner, all excited to pick up a nice ready-made shirt, maybe even a pair of trousers. The store has a sleek and classy vibe that instantly makes you feel like you’re in for something special. But to our surprise, we soon found out that they don’t keep any ready-made shirts or pants for immediate purchase.

They explained that everything is made-to-order and it takes about three to four working days after you select the fabric, style, and measurements. While the concept is great for people looking for custom clothing and a more personal touch, we were honestly a bit disappointed because we were hoping to buy something instantly.

That said, the staff was polite and took the time to explain their process in detail. They showed us the fabric options and tailoring styles, which were quite impressive. It’s a great place if you’re looking to invest in custom-made clothing and are okay with waiting a few days for a more tailored experience.

But if you’re someone who enjoys browsing and picking something off the shelf to wear the same day, this might not be the right place. We left without a purchase but with a better understanding of their concept. Maybe we’ll return when we have the time and patience for something made just for us.

featured_reviews.name: Akash Bhatt
featured_reviews.review_text:
Title: A Stellar Experience at Bombay Shirt Company, Kemps Corner, Mumbai!

I had the absolute pleasure of visiting Bombay Shirt Company at Kemps Corner, Mumbai, and I can confidently say it was an extraordinary experience that exceeded all my expectations. The impeccable service and attention to detail have won me over as a delighted and satisfied customer.

From the moment I walked into the store, I was warmly greeted by Rahul Z and Neha. Their enthusiasm and expertise in guiding me through the process of creating my custom shirts were remarkable. They patiently listened to my preferences and offered valuable style suggestions, ensuring that the end product would be nothing short of perfect. Their dedication to providing top-notch customer service was evident, and I felt valued as a customer throughout my visit.

I must also extend my gratitude to the rest of the staff members who were equally courteous and attentive. It's evident that the entire team at Bombay Shirt Company shares a passion for delivering exceptional service, and their collective efforts make the shopping experience truly memorable.

The master tailor, who took my measurements, was not only skilled but also incredibly helpful. His expertise in understanding the nuances of fit and style was evident as he meticulously measured me. He was patient in addressing any queries I had, and I left the store with the utmost confidence that my shirts would fit like a glove.

The process of designing my shirts was both fun and straightforward. I was kept informed at every step, from selecting fabrics to choosing collar styles and buttons. The array of high-quality materials and customization options available is impressive, allowing me to create shirts that perfectly match my preferences.

When my shirts were ready for fitting, I was thrilled with the results. The fit was flawless, and the craftsmanship was outstanding. Each shirt felt like a work of art, and I could tell that immense care had gone into their creation.

I am immensely grateful to Rahul Z, Neha, and the entire team at Bombay Shirt Company for making this experience so enjoyable and rewarding. Your dedication to providing exceptional customer service is truly commendable.

I highly recommend Bombay Shirt Company to anyone in search of premium, made-to-measure shirts in Mumbai. Thank you for surpassing my expectations and for the exceptional service.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I don't think I can say enough about this store, you will need one full day to go thru their collections, they bring in all the brands from pakistan and if they don't have a brand they will happily order it for you, I'm a regular here since the past 6 years and there's not a single time that I haven't found clothes that I absolutely love, the owner is so sweet and we have a very good relation. The staff is so smart and active with showing stock. A lot of times when I've not been able to visit I quickly book it online and the next Day the suit is in My hand, the delivery is so quick and the best best part about this store is their instagram handle, they post photos and videos of each and every outfit so even if you can visit or live in a different state, you won't hesitate before ordering, I honestly can't recommend them enough. Alhamdulillah shopping has become so easy for me.
They have menswear and ready to wear too
As I said I can't appreciate the stock enough
You will just have to visit them and find out for yourself

featured_reviews.name: Sana Zubair khan
featured_reviews.review_text: Always a great experience shopping here and I'm a regular customer here. They've got exclusive and unique variety of dresses/ suits to choose from. I have zero complaints from the past many years. They're awesome

featured_reviews.name: Aliya Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Highly recommend this store.
Stunning collection and the prices are so so good as compared to other stores in Mumbai. My entire family shops from here and every time I wear an outfit from them I only get compliments. Masha Allah amazing

featured_reviews.name: Atiullah Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing experience at Panche Lawn Studio, Mumbai Central.

It honestly felt like they were trying to clear old stock in the name of Ramzan offers. The staff were instructed to show only selected designs, and whenever we asked for better or newer pieces, they kept saying, “All good designs are sold out.” That’s hard to believe when the collection on display itself looked limited and outdated.

Customer service was also not up to the mark. Instead of genuinely helping customers choose something nice, the focus seemed more on pushing specific items.

Overall, not a satisfying shopping experience. I would recommend improving transparency and customer service rather than using festive seasons as a marketing excuse.

featured_reviews.name: Alina Munawwer
featured_reviews.review_text:
I purchased 3 suits from them and the suits are very beautiful. The fabric is so soft, colours are great, print is beautiful, embroidery is perfect.
There pricing was good too. I will purchase from them in the future too now I became their permanent client.
I recommended their page to so many people because they have so much variety of brands and their pricing are good too.

featured_reviews.name: Fiza Kokni
featured_reviews.review_text: Panache lawn studio have authentic and wide range of collection. Customer service is also great and I always receive the dress through courier within short time.

featured_reviews.name: Dar iqra
featured_reviews.review_text: This place is a gem for anyone looking for original lawn suits! They have an incredible variety that covers everything from casual wear to special occasions.

featured_reviews.review_text: A great option to buy cotton and silk kurtas and tops. A nice change from having to visit Fabindia! Plenty of cute prints and really comfortable fits. The only suggestion I have is to add lining for all dresses as it’s impossible to wear them as dresses without the lining. The price range is about 500-1000 rs. for a kurta! featured_reviews.review_text: This store has the worst customer service the staff is not at all friendly and welcoming, they have a problem if you touch any clothes hanging there and expecting us not to ask questions . It’s been years and still no change, makes me not want to enter the store at all

featured_reviews.name: SHAZNIN DAS
featured_reviews.review_text: A wide range of Indian women's clothing . Pastels ruled . I feel , it's an expensive clothing store as a dress which would be worth Rs 2000 to Rs 3000 was tagged at Rs 6900 +. Staff are polite and do know their products .

featured_reviews.name: Nima Das
featured_reviews.review_text:
I used to be a regular customer here but now I am not stepping into this  store again. I bought this very expensive Kurta for 7k and wore it once and the arm hole tore because the material was so weak. When I went to show them they said leave it with us lets see and after a week when I went they said this kurta is all sold out and that they can’t do anything and I will have to just buy another one!! How outrageous is this! They refused to take responsibility for repair or give me a replacement!! And this kurta wasn’t even tight or anything, it was my size. My tailor said the material was very weak and not good so it tore.
They have lost a customer.
Please buy clothes from here only if you have to because they don’t take responsibility for any thing. They only want to sell!! And to top it all their sales persons at the chowpatty store are so untrained and impolite. They act like they are doing a big favour to you, very very rude staff. I mean there are so many shops like these- just go visit Kalaghoda or bandra you will find a 1000 stores to buy better quality stuff.

featured_reviews.name: Jigna
featured_reviews.review_text: My recent visit was disappointed by the customer service. The staff were not welcoming and came across as rude, which made my shopping experience uncomfortable. Customer service is a big part of what makes or breaks a visit, and unfortunately, this experience fell short. I hope the management takes steps to improve this aspect in the future, as it's crucial for customer satisfaction…

featured_reviews.name: Kavita Mohite
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was a big fan of seasons bagh. But had a bad experience with them. One of my kurtas colours ran and I couldn’t wear it again , when I went to them with it , unfortunately they just put their hands up
Saying they can’t do anything.

featured_reviews.name: Sarah Montague
featured_reviews.review_text:
RUDE- I will not step into this store again.
The 'assistant' laughed in my face when I asked for 'long trousers', I'm tall. I could not believe her horrendous attitude. A second assistant made no attempt at an apology for this insulting behaviour. I hope Bagh invest in some staff training ....but I won't return.😡

name: Shyamal & Bhumika
description:
Bhumika and Shyamal Shodhan are fashion designers from India. They believe that hand-made is a rare luxury we inherit, having their base in India. Their detailed workmanship is a reflection of the essence of India, its artisans and craft. Keeping alive a heritage through the medium of fashion creating collections for an equally passionate global muse.
The SHYAMAL & BHUMIKA brand stands for effortless luxury and a sense of accomplishment mastered from designing timeless outfits which can be handed over from generation to generation.
Shyamal & Bhumika’s collection retail from their flagship stores in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Ahmedabad and Los Angeles as well as their website .
address: Ground Floor, Mohammedbhai Mansion next to Crossword, below Kemps Corner Flyover, N S Patkar Marg, Cumballa Hill, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400026

featured_reviews.name: shivani jangid
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Shyamal & Bhumika for my wedding was one of the best decisions I made.The outfit felt like a dream, timeless, elegant, and crafted with such attention to detail. From the silhouettes to the intricate workmanship, everything reflected luxury with soul.

I felt confident, graceful, and truly myself in every ensemble. The team especially Nikita was warm, patient, and understood my vision perfectly, making the entire experience seamless and special.

Thank you, Shyamal & Bhumika, for creating my outfit that didn’t just dress me for my wedding, but became a part of my memories forever. ✨

featured_reviews.name: Chahat Saini
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had the pleasure of visiting your stunning Mumbai store at Kemps Corner, and I'm absolutely delighted to share my enchanting bridal journey experience. After exploring collections from top designers like Sabyasachi, Tarun Tahiliani, and Rimple & Harpreet, I chose Shyamal & Bhumika bridal lehenga, and it was a standout piece that truly wone me over.

The moment I entered the store, the staff's warm welcome and enthusiasm in showcasing their best bridal collection made me feel at home. I especially want to thank Dhanashree, Aanchal and Nidhi for their exceptional service and support throughout my journey. For any query or support Dhanashree was always available. My family, including my mom and sister, were equally impressed with the collection and the staff's courtesy, and they ended up buying outfits too!

I was also fortunate to meet Shyamal sir, and I personally shared my feedback with him. The entire experience was truly memorable, and your team's dedication to customer service made my special day even more special. Thank you for making it a moment I'll cherish forever!

featured_reviews.name: aahana patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Shyamal & Bhumika Mumbai store gave me the most incredible experience while finding my reception outfit. They helped me choose the perfect look and got everything done so quickly without compromising on quality. The craftsmanship was impeccable and the stitching was absolutely perfect. Everything fit like a dream.

A huge thank you to Dhanashree, who was so attentive, kind, and thoughtful throughout the process. She communicated clearly at every step and even surprised me with a matching purse for my special day, which was such a sweet and thoughtful touch.

I could not have asked for a better experience and would highly recommend this store to anyone looking for something truly special.

featured_reviews.name: Radhika Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
Choosing Shyamal Bhumika lehnga as a groom's mother for the wedding was a perfect decision. I loved the lehnga the moment my eyes fell on it. The colour , the workmanship , the fitting was perfect. I felt like a bride myself - confident, elegant, graceful and regal. I have received so many complements - will cherish the experience for ever.
Thank you to the entire team for making me look beautiful for one of the most important occassions of my life - my son's wedding. Special thanks to Bhumika who was suprisingly at the store when I was deciding - she helped me make the decision effortlessly with her creative inputs.
Dhanashree from the team was especially helpful with her patient and warm demeanor through all the trials.

featured_reviews.name: Raj Hothi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had another fantastic experience thanks to Sagar Varyani. He is always professional, polite, attentive, helpful and incredibly prompt. I’ve placed orders with  Shyamal & Bhumika for the past few years and always had a great experience, and I’m so pleased to say it’s been exactly the same again this time with Sagar.

Sagar has made the whole process so easy and stress-free — communication is clear and helpful from start to finish, and nothing ever feels like too much trouble. It’s a pleasure dealing with someone so reliable and genuinely customer-focused and I feel I am in trusted hands.

The outfits are high-quality and beautifully presented, and the service throughout has been absolutely fantastic. You can really tell they take pride in what they do.

I wouldn’t hesitate to order again and highly recommend Sagar to anyone looking for great service and quality products.

featured_reviews.name: Ishika Bhanushali
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved my experience at Shyamal & Bhumika! The wedding outfit was everything I had hoped for—elegant, beautifully crafted, and fit like a dream.
A big thank you to Nikita, who was an absolute blessing through the entire process. She really understood what I was looking for. From suggestions to fittings, she made everything smooth and stress-free, and ensured every detail was perfect.
Thank you, Shyamal & Bhumika team, for creating something so memorable. Highly recommend to any bride looking for timeless,  wedding wear .

featured_reviews.name: niketa virani
featured_reviews.review_text: I recently wore a lehenga from Shyamal and bhumika and I felt absolutely beautiful in it. The fit, detailing, and finishing were just perfect. The craftsmanship truly reflects the effort and creativity behind the design. I received so many compliments! Highly recommend for anyone looking for something elegant and special.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Barad
featured_reviews.review_text: Nikita helped me find the perfect sangeet outfit. She was so receptive when even after I came back to the USA. The store was punctual in delivering the dress the exact time they predicted. They also took the blouse back and quickly did alterations when it didn't fit correctly. I would highly recommend this store and I hope to wear more Shyamal Bhumika outfits in the future!
